category_reviews.title: Core Concepts
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked ownership, retained presence, dice, sequencing, physical distance and morale. Orders 84–86 and 90 supply result overrides, deemed contact, 1 mm quarters and off-battlefield revival. No additional defect reproduced; merged repairs remain distinct from a clause certificate.

category_reviews.title: Datasheets
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked terminal modifiers, canonical keywords, random profiles, source-dash interactions and healing. Orders 87–89 and 93 supply the prior missing owners. Mixed random Movement grouping remains the explicitly provisional owner convention; no independent source confirmation is invented.

category_reviews.title: Moving
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed path versus setup distinction, coherency, model order, zero-distance moves, terrain, maximum-approach proofs and prevalidation. Orders 73–76 fix documented cases; finite solver cases are not a universal completeness proof.

category_reviews.title: Making Attacks
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked physical weapon selection, target replacement, grouping and splitting. Orders 91–92 resolve the prior findings, but C04-06 still prevents declining all ranged targets when a legal target exists. Random melee commitment timing retains the owner-approved provisional convention.

category_reviews.title: Attack Sequence
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked hit/wound criticals, allocation, saves, damage, retained destruction and result overrides. New C24-11 crosses the shared wound path: Twin-linked bypasses submitted choices. Reproduced in Shooting and Fight, including exact restore/replay.

category_reviews.title: Other Concepts
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed corridor visibility, mortal-wound priority and decisions, hazardous sequencing and FNP. Both mixed-keyword Hazard FAQs route to the shared unit damage service; no new defect identified in this survey.

category_reviews.title: The Battle Round
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked five-phase order, alternating active players, round increment and boundary priority through lifecycle/timing owners and existing regressions. These family tests include engine-level cases; a complete clause-specific facade certificate remains open. Normal Move, control-first and Action interruption consumers are explicitly revalidated below.

category_reviews.title: Command Phase
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed start sequencing before CP, gain caps, persistent shock, half-strength threshold, embarked/reserve candidates and test deduplication. Historical partial Command package status must be interpreted with the later off-battlefield overlay.

category_reviews.title: Movement Phase
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked ordinary/reactive phase occurrence, movement types, Desperate Escape, mixed presence and random Movement. Order 80 distinguishes the turn owner; duplicate 09.07.01 headings remain separate identities. Random Movement grouping retains the Order 87 convention.

category_reviews.title: Shooting Phase
category_reviews.assessment: Order 91 now offers legal unit/type selection without viable attacks. The reachable-target control exposes C04-06 after selecting Normal Shooting: an empty declaration is schema-invalid and no decline option exists. Retained Shooting shares the declaration boundary; it is a traced additional consumer, not a separately replayed counterexample.

category_reviews.title: Charge Phase
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked charge range/rolls, target replacement, full paths, mandatory endpoints and Flight timing. Order 85 now supplies deemed contact. Existing witnesses, analytic certificates and typed unresolved results remain authoritative; finite tests are not a universal geometry proof.

category_reviews.title: Fight Phase
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked mandatory activation/pass, Fights First, pile-in and all consolidation modes. C12-04 retains the owner v946 Engaging-only resolution. Order 92 implements random melee splitting under its provisional timing convention. C24-11 is reproduced through this attack host.

category_reviews.title: Terrain
category_reviews.assessment: Revisited terrain revalidation: terrain areas versus features, cover, detection, Hidden and causal concealment. Order 78 covers Gone to Ground outside dense terrain; preserve exact solver unresolved results as errors, never visibility answers.

category_reviews.title: Objectives
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed marker/terrain geometry, control sums, tied control, securing and phase/turn-end precedence. Order 79 protects control before cleanup; Aircraft dash OC is not a numeric control counterexample.

category_reviews.title: Stratagems
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked Core Stratagem selection, CP bounds, affected-unit scope and Snap. Select the complete Order 94 40k.app 15.11 observation instead of the known-truncated GDM body. Command Re-roll automatic component resolution follows an explicit submitted Stratagem choice; this is not the unsubmitted Twin-linked choice.

category_reviews.title: Actions
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed eligibility, no-shoot/no-charge duration, Battle-shock, completed-move interruption, departures and exceptions. Order 77 repairs return-to-start paths. Complete family/viewer/replay coverage still needs clause-level sign-off.

category_reviews.title: Monsters And Vehicles
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed Normal/Advance friendly transit and engaged shooting target/model scopes. Order 71 tests both penalty causes and close-quarters target exception; no additional defect identified.

category_reviews.title: Transports
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked capacity, embark setup embargo, all disembark modes, ingress restrictions, Hazard timing and maximal emergency placement. C18-07 retains the owner resolution based on passengers post-placement engagement. Order 90 supplies full-health cargo revival and later ingress; no new transport defect reproduced.

category_reviews.title: Attached Units
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked rules-unit identity, physical ownership, component lineage, keywords, attached destruction and revival. Orders 89–90 supply scoped healing and off-battlefield returns; source model ownership stays distinct from rules-unit membership.

category_reviews.title: Strategic Reserves
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked initial reserve limits, cargo points, ingress/arrival, removal deadlines and post-arrival restriction lifetimes. Order 90 now supports non-spatial revival in reserves, preserving presence and later ingress. No new reserve defect reproduced.

category_reviews.title: Flying and Surging
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed Take to the Skies timing and movement cost, Hover, Surge trigger/Battle-shock/engagement/history, fixed-target approach and Aircraft exclusions. Flight/Heavy vertical-distance regression explicitly retained.

category_reviews.title: Other Rules And Abilities
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed self-Aura and duplicate identity, faction ownership gate, leveled Psychic per-phase use, wargear bearer loss and Plunging Fire. Psychic use key already includes active player, round and phase; not the old Normal Move bug.

category_reviews.title: Aircraft
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed mandatory reserves, ingress-only movement, opponent turn-end removal, transit and targeting/melee/flying restrictions. Hover preserves AIRCRAFT identity. No new defect identified in this survey.

category_reviews.title: Core Abilities
category_reviews.assessment: Rechecked all Core ability headings, model/unit scope and shared attack/movement consumers. C24-11: Twin-linked forces rerolls of failed wounds, omits successful-roll options and embeds an invented result in an event instead of submitting a player choice. C04-06 repair must preserve selected-weapon Hazardous/One Shot semantics; no separate unproven defect is claimed.

category_reviews.title: Muster Armies
category_reviews.assessment: Reviewed 1000/2000 limits, single 3DP Incursion exception, duplicate counts, faction/detachment restrictions, Support attachment, model Warlord/bearer and Upgrade exceptions. Orders 67–69 retained; no faction catalog certification inferred.

findings.summary: A selected eligible Shooting unit cannot decline every ranged target when a legal target exists.
findings.invariant: Every source-authorized player choice uses the shared decision path; declining ranged targets must not require an illegal declaration.
findings.required_repair: Add a source-correct target-declining path for ordinary and retained/out-of-phase hosts. Preserve selected physical weapon identity separately from attacks, Hazardous and One Shot semantics, shooting-type and cargo restrictions, Action eligibility, invalid atomicity, both viewers and replay. Update the adapter contract and generated identity if it changes.
findings.evidence_limit: Ordinary Shooting facade rejection plus legal declaration control; shared retained declaration boundary is inspected, not separately replayed.

findings.summary: Twin-linked automatically rerolls failed wounds and withholds rerolls of successful wounds.
findings.invariant: Optional rerolls must be player decisions, including a legal successful wound reroll; an event containing an engine-invented result is not a submitted decision.
findings.required_repair: Route intrinsic Twin-linked through the shared source-backed optional reroll decision and resume authority. Include decline and successful-roll rerolls, once-per-die and override precedence, Command Re-roll/source overlap, Shooting/Fight/retained consumers, stale submissions, pending restore, viewers and exact replay. Audit all automatic reroll callers for an already-submitted authorizing choice.
findings.evidence_limit: Automatic unsubmitted rerolls reproduced through Shooting and Fight with exact restore and replay; successful-roll exclusion is a directly inspected early return, not a separately submitted successful reroll counterexample.

findings.summary: The observed corpus is indexed by source row and category family, but its compound clauses, source equivalence and individual facade assertions are not yet fully mapped.
findings.invariant: Every operative Core clause and FAQ needs explicit immutable source, engine-owner and assertion evidence before final certification; family references cannot substitute for that inventory.
findings.required_repair: Build the complete operative-clause and FAQ evidence inventory before PFINAL: distinguish semantic clauses from examples/metadata, select complete immutable transcriptions, reconcile each current runtime source row including supersessions and owner conventions, and name exact engine owners and assertion-bearing facade/replay/viewer regressions. Add missing proofs for Heavy movement-to-attack history and Category 07 phase boundaries. Any further source ambiguity or gameplay defect receives a scoped repair before PFINAL; preserve prior negative audits.
findings.evidence_limit: Source row/block counts and category-family tests establish survey coverage only. This is an audit-evidence deficiency, not a claim that all 345 rows contain gameplay defects.

cross_category_reviews.assessment: Finite and parameterized reactive moves, attached units, actual turn owner, both viewers, persistence and exact replay. This specifically rechecks 09.05.01 across category 07 phase occurrences.
Freeze control before end-turn rules and cleanup; source-loaded choice, Action expiry, both viewers and exact replay. Aircraft departure is event-order evidence only: source-dash OC is zero.
Validated completed movement, including return to original pose, interrupts the Action; decline does not. Shared history interpretation is independent of net displacement.
Timing/history facade evidence plus direct real-domain Heavy calculation. The per-model vertical-distance test is not a facade attack certificate; that remaining combined proof is explicitly open.
Keep C12-04 Engaging-only owner App v946 and C18-07 passenger post-placement engagement resolutions. Historical v931 Ongoing wording is superseded, not silently reintroduced.
Category 07 explicit revalidation: phase/turn/round progression and source-scoped interleaving. Engine-level lifecycle tests are not presented as all-clause facade coverage.
The complete 40k.app observation and official PDF reconciliation from Order 94 remain selected for 15.11; GDM truncation is retained, not upgraded.

Source-preserving individual modifier choices, physical owners, stale/invalid atomicity and viewer/restore authority. Order 93 explicitly unsupported contexts without a sourced producer remain outside this claim.

complete_game_performance.reason: No complete-game workload was run. This PR changes no runtime code; component measurements and correctness tests do not certify the full-game targets.

limits: A complete source-row/block survey is not an individually certified operative-clause inventory. All clause-certification flags remain open; no block count is presented as a semantic rule count.
Family owner and regression references are trace anchors. PEVIDENCE must supply source equivalence, per-clause assertions and all applicable facade/viewer/replay proofs before the fresh PFINAL audit.
No whole-corpus official App capture or co-versioned mirror equivalence is claimed. Known 15.11 truncation selects the complete Order 94 observation.

Two reproduced gameplay defects and the complete clause-evidence deficit require separate prerequisite orders before a fresh main-branch audit. Historical audits and runtime source statuses are not rewritten.
Mixed random Movement and random melee attack commitment retain Orders 87 and 92 owner conventions, not newly established official source semantics.
